// FILE android/app/Instrumentation.java
package android.app;
import android.content.Context;
public class Instrumentation  {
    public final Context context=new Context();
    public int mainCalls;
    public boolean diagnosticsActive;
    public int diagnosticInstalls;
    public int diagnosticCleanups;
    public int initializations;
    public boolean installedBeforeInitialize;
    public Context getTargetContext() {
        return context;
    }
    public void runOnMainSync(Runnable r) {
        mainCalls++;
        r.run();
    }
}

// FILE android/content/Context.java
package android.content;
public class Context  {
    public String getPackageName() {
        return "com.example";
    }
}

// FILE android/util/Log.java
package android.util;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
public class Log  {
    public static final List<String> messages=new ArrayList<>();
    public static int i(String tag,String message) {
        messages.add(tag+":"+message);
        return 0;
    }
    public static int w(String tag,String message) {
        return i(tag,message);
    }
}

// FILE androidx/test/platform/app/InstrumentationRegistry.java
package androidx.test.platform.app;
import android.app.Instrumentation;
public class InstrumentationRegistry  {
    public static Instrumentation instrumentation;
    public static Instrumentation getInstrumentation() {
        return instrumentation;
    }
}

// FILE androidx/test/uiautomator/UiDevice.java
package androidx.test.uiautomator;
import android.app.Instrumentation;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import pl.leancode.patrol.PatrolJUnitRunner;
public class UiDevice  {
    public static final List<String> commands=new ArrayList<>();
    private final PatrolJUnitRunner runner;
    private UiDevice(PatrolJUnitRunner runner)  {
        this.runner = runner;
    }
    public static UiDevice getInstance(Instrumentation instrumentation)  {
        return new UiDevice((PatrolJUnitRunner) instrumentation);
    }
    public String executeShellCommand(String command) throws IOException  {
        commands.add(command+"|initializations="+runner.initializations+"|setups="+runner.setups);
        if (runner.failure.equals("grant")) throw new IOException("grant");
        return "";
    }
}

// FILE pl/leancode/patrol/Automator.java
package pl.leancode.patrol;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;
public class Automator {
    public static final Companion Companion = new Companion();
    public static class Companion {
        public Automator getInstance() { return new Automator(); }
    }
    public void initialize() {
        PatrolJUnitRunner runner =
                (PatrolJUnitRunner) InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation();
        runner.initializations++;
        runner.installedBeforeInitialize = runner.diagnosticsActive;
        if (runner.failure.equals("initialize")) throw new IllegalStateException("initialize");
    }
}

// FILE pl/leancode/patrol/PatrolJUnitRunner.java
package pl.leancode.patrol;
import android.app.Instrumentation;
public class PatrolJUnitRunner extends Instrumentation  {
    public String failure = "";
    public int calls;
    public boolean installedBeforeSetup;
    public int setups;
    private void stage(String name)  {
        if (failure.equals(name)) throw new IllegalStateException(name);
    }
    public void setUp(Class<?> activity)  {
        setups++;
        installedBeforeSetup = diagnosticsActive;
        stage("setup");
    }
    public void waitForPatrolAppService()  {
        stage("wait");
    }
    public Object[] listDartTests()  {
        stage("list");
        return failure.equals("match") ? new Object[0] : new Object[] {
            "observer_test probe"
        }
        ;
    }
    public void runDartTest(String description)  {
        calls++;
        stage("run");
    }
}

// FILE mplatrol/e2e/NativeActivityDiagnostics.java
package mplatrol.e2e;
import android.app.Instrumentation;
public final class NativeActivityDiagnostics  {
    public static int installs;
    public static int cleanups;
    public static Runnable install(Instrumentation instrumentation)  {
        installs++;
        instrumentation.diagnosticInstalls++;
        instrumentation.diagnosticsActive = true;
        return () ->  {
            cleanups++;
            instrumentation.diagnosticCleanups++;
            instrumentation.diagnosticsActive = false;
        }
        ;
    }
}

// FILE com/example/MainActivity.java
package com.example;
public final class MainActivity  {
}

// FILE org/junit/Assert.java
package org.junit;
public final class Assert  {
    public static void assertTrue(String message, boolean condition)  {
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }
}
